subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` as a core sensitive-state artifact contract now, or keep it draft until the Scout/Lobster pilot and stress harness prove the operational boundary?
rationale: The code blockers are mechanical, but automation cannot decide whether this sensitive backup artifact schema belongs in core now versus a host/plugin path or a later proof threshold.

options.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
options.body: Require the lockfile and stale-policy cleanup first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.

options.title: Land Core MVP After Cleanup
options.body: Accept the local-only core command once the concrete blockers are fixed and security/product reviewers approve the sensitive artifact boundary.

options.title: Defer Core And Keep Host-Owned First
options.body: Keep the behavior in a host/plugin path until maintainers see a missing core API or stronger general OpenClaw need.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
recommendation.body: Require the lockfile and stale-policy cleanup first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.
